title: mean
description: Diagnostic tool for analyzing and computing mean values for FSL data.

forcedir_flag.description: Use the actual directory name given - i.e. don't add + to make a new directory
forcedir_flag.title: Force directory flag

inference_tech.description: Inference technique: mcmc or laplace (default is mcmc)
inference_tech.title: Inference technique

num_jumps.description: Number of jumps to be made by MCMC (default is 5000)
num_jumps.title: Number of jumps

num_burnin.description: Number of jumps at start of MCMC to be discarded (default is 500)
num_burnin.title: Number of burn-in jumps

num_sample_every.description: Number of jumps for each sample (MCMC) (default is 1)
num_sample_every.title: Number of jumps per sample

num_update_proposalevery.description: Number of jumps for each update to the proposal density std (MCMC) (default is 40)
num_update_proposalevery.title: Number of jumps per proposal update

acceptance_rate.description: Acceptance rate to aim for (MCMC) (default is 0.6)
acceptance_rate.title: Acceptance rate

seed.description: Seed for pseudo random number generator
seed.title: Seed

error_precision.description: Value to fix error precision to (default is -1, which means error precision is not fixed)
error_precision.title: Error precision

noamp_flag.description: Turn off Analytical Marginalisation of error Precision
noamp_flag.title: No AMP flag
